"''Just get the audit back on track.|Bureau of Standards employee offering to backup the offices transport schedules for Syril Karn|}} A [[human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] was an '''employee''' of the [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]], working at its [[Bureau of Standards Ghorman field office|field office]] on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] in [[3 BBY]]. They were at the field office when the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] conducted a search for [[listening device]] in the office. Following the search, they offered to back up the transport schedules for [[Syril Karn]], the office's [[Division Chief]] so he could make his flight to [[Coruscant]]. But Karn instead asked them to get the audit the office was conducting back on track. They had tan skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s and black [[hair]]. While working at the field office they wore a dark grey [[clothing|vest]] over a grey high collared shirt with matching dark grey pants and a black tie.{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} ==Behind the scenes== The employee appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The employee was portrayed by [[Anushka Chakravarti]] and was listed in the series' credits as simply "BOS #1". ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1st|"[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]"}} *{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} *{{Andor|Who Are You?}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=სტანდარტების ბიუროს უცნობი თანამშრომელი 1 }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Bureau of Standards employees]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
